summary: Object factory: invokes an interface callback at offset 0x6A of the caller-supplied interface, applies a byte accumulation to a pointer, calls the base constructor ConstructorWithByteParams with two byte parameters, stores the input byte a2 at object offset 228 (0xE4), installs vtable off_5A00F0 at the object head, and returns the constructed object pointer. Signature is userpurge, returning the object in eax with the interface in esi.

operations.description: Invoke function pointer stored at interface offset 0x6A (106) on the caller-supplied interface a1.
Accumulate the high byte of v3 into the byte pointed to by v2 (source register edx); v2/v3 provenance is a decompiler artifact and unresolved.
Call base constructor ConstructorWithByteParams with byte parameters v6 and v7.
Store the input byte a2 at new object offset 228 (0xE4).
Install vtable pointer off_5A00F0 at the head of the new object.
Return the new object pointer in eax.
